notablePrerequisites: Barrage Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Barrage Ogre by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Barrage Orge ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.
